scope: Current evidence-led selection across every foundation layer and all four domain research layers. Named alternatives have explicit dispositions; the wider repository inventory remains discovery and historical research.
new_pc_scope: Documented Linux/WSL2 x86_64 adoption baseline. Each destination host must establish its own sign-in, scoped integrations and useful behavior. Cross-platform and complete second-physical-PC acceptance are not established.
rules: Selected means the supported choice for the stated task and scope; it does not mean universal benchmark winner.
Only an actual retained execution result can support observed_failure. Unqualified, overlapping, conditional and out-of-scope candidates did not thereby fail a test.
Primary source review, actual native operation, local integration tests and comparative measurements are different evidence depths.
A current release or repository activity check does not supersede an accepted pin without a relevant compatibility or improvement result.
The current layer decision takes precedence over historical candidate-card recommendations. Historical dates, failures and original source pins remain visible.
Counts are derived from canonical records. Metadata coverage, receipt integrity and reviewer agreement do not prove performance superiority.
The canonical index public_star flag describes the historical baseline ledger; current membership and the HTML star filter use the dated freshness snapshot.
Reopen a selection when its stated overturning comparison meets the requirement; retain competitive alternatives until then.
